subject: Trading
title: Mt. Gox: The First Big Hack
description: One-minute skill: Mt. Gox: The First Big Hack.

hook.text: Mt. Gox handled 70% of all Bitcoin trades in 2013. Then 850,000 bitcoin disappeared from its vaults.

buildup.text: Founded as a Magic: The Gathering card exchange, it pivoted to Bitcoin and grew far beyond its capacity.

discovery.text: Hackers exploited a flaw in how Mt. Gox tracked withdrawals, draining coins slowly over months.

twist.text: CEO Mark Karpeles didn't notice the theft until the exchange was already insolvent. Customers lost everything.

climax.text: Mt. Gox showed that centralized crypto custodians carry the same risks as any unregulated financial institution.

punchline.text: A card-trading site lost a billion in Bitcoin.

quiz.question: What was Mt. Gox originally designed for?
